title: Module B — LLM Evidence Layer
description: Output of the Gemini evidence module. One document per repository. Produces a repo summary, candidate skill labels, natural-language evidence and embedding similarity. Deliberately has NO confidence or score field — scoring belongs to Module C. additionalProperties:false enforces that.

prompt_version.description: Bump when the prompt changes so old rows are re-generatable.

repo_summary.description: One-paragraph description of what the repository does. Written once at ingestion, reused for every JD.

skills.description: Candidate skills the model believes the repo demonstrates. A label here is a claim, not a verdict — Module C decides how much it counts.

skill_id.description: Resolved against the SKILL vocabulary when the label matches a canonical skill; null when the model proposed a skill outside the vocabulary.

nl_evidence.description: How the skill shows up in this repo, in one sentence. Goes into SKILL_EVIDENCE.evidence and later into ai_summarize.

semantic_similarity.description: Cosine similarity between the canonical skill description embedding and the repo content embedding. An observable measurement, not a model judgement.

referenced_files.description: Files the model cited when writing nl_evidence, so the claim can be checked.
